[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Agen Kolar/Legends|Agen Kolar]] possessed a '''lightsaber''' that he wielded during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
[[File:Kolar-Geonosis.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Kolar wielding the green-bladed lightsaber on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]]]]
Agen Kolar used the lightsaber during the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]] against the [[Battle droid/Legends|Battle droid]] forces of [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]].<ref name="Attack of the Clones" /> He would continue to use it during the clone wars in an attempt to arrest [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]]<ref name="Republic 54">[[Republic 54|''Republic'' 54]]</ref>

On one such occasion, Kolar and fellow Masters [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] and [[Voolvif Monn]] engaged [[LM-432 crab droid/Legends|crab droids]] on an [[Unidentified icy planet|icy planet]] but got trapped by their [[Bubble wort projector/Legends|bubble wort projectors]]. Kolar had begun using a lightsaber with a red [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|focusing crystal]] instead of a green one,<ref name="Clone Wars 22">{{CW|22}}</ref> though he began wielding a blue-bladed lightsaber only a few months later.<ref name="Revenge of the Sith" />

The lightsaber saw its final use near the end of the war when Agen Kolar was sent to arrest [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] along with three other Jedi Masters, Although Kolar was swiftly struck down by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]].<ref name="Revenge of the Sith" />
